reviews.title: Accuracy
reviews.text: Needs to be more accurate one of my meals was logged as 170cals less than what was in it

reviews.title: Not working for me.
reviews.text: I was unable to edit the weight of ingredients and it calculated 15 g of Greek yoghurt at nearly 4000 calories. Their support response in an email was to say food needs to be well lit and I can edit the portion size if needed!

reviews.title: Hate the new 13 august 26 update!!!!
reviews.text: My beloved cat with a fork disappeared and a new ugly and absolutely not cute chick appeared. I want the new interface back. I liked it so much when my eaten calories would fill the cute cat with a fork. Now it’s no fun at all!!!

reviews.title: Вона вибила і тепер я не можу зайти. Оплатила на рік. Служба допомоги не відповідає
reviews.text: Дуже часто не розпізнає елементарну їжу

reviews.title: Nespokojnosť
reviews.text: Zakúpila som si aplikáciu, ale už teraz viem, že poznám lepšie. Keď do aplikácie opíšem jedlo ( napr. Hruška Konference 83 g), tak nevie položku načítať, prepočítava aj po resete. Za mňa strata peňazí. Bohužiaľ.

reviews.title: Issue with Paid Version – Calz App
reviews.text:
Hello,

I purchased the paid version of the Calz app, but for the past 4–5 evenings I have not been able to log my calories. The AI features, including scanning and voice input, are not working.

If this is not fixed soon, I will have to cancel my subscription and switch to a more stable app.

Thank you for your attention.

reviews.title: Stopped working
reviews.text: I paid for the yearly subscription and it was working great for the first few days then just stopped working! It won’t let me scan, take photos or even use the voice recognition to upload my food. Really disappointed

reviews.title: Scanning not working
reviews.text: Since the last update, the scanning does not seem to work and after using this app consecutively over last year, I am now considering switching to another

reviews.title: I can’t go to my account and I can’t download a foto and scan
reviews.text: I can’t go to my account and I can’t download a foto and scan

reviews.title: Працює тільки за кошти. Немає нормального інтерфейсу для безкоштовного використання.
reviews.text: Немає можливості навіть самим писати продукти тільки за гроші навіть якщо не хочеш використовувати сканер. Не рекомендую вам.

reviews.title: Treba to vylepšiť 🙈
reviews.text: Chýba rozdelenie jedál na raňajky, olovrant, obed, večera, prípadne druhá večera. Teraz to tam je všetko na kopu a veľmi neprehľadné. Taktiež chýba možnosť uložiť si vlastné jedlo (ak si robíte nejaký šejk z viacerých jedál). Nebolo by potrebné zadávať 5 jedál každý deň, ale vybrali by ste si vami uložený "šejk" napríklad.
